title: Attributable denial: what it uses

steps.title: Privilege gateway model routes
steps.what: Wrong-provider and model-allowlist refusals are 403 responses on the model routes whose body names the reason.
steps.why: When a model call is refused, the operator and the auditor need to know which control refused it and why.
